intro:
Moving across Camp Hill? Jimmys Removals provides an efficient, fully insured moving service for residents in this redeveloped north-west district of Nuneaton. From eco-friendly modern townhouses along Cedar Road and Copperaminster Way to established post-war family homes on Willow Road, our staff take exceptional care of your possessions. We operate reliable 3.5-tonne Luton vehicles equipped with 500kg tail lifts, heavy-duty quilted covers, and furniture blankets.

Our porters arrive punctually, ready to shoulder the physical strain of moving day. We disassemble flat-pack bunks and wardrobes, pad delicate electronics, and navigate bulky armchairs through narrow doorways with patience. Clear upfront pricing ensures you stay on budget from start to finish.
